about_the_game:
Tic Tac is a 2D cooperative action-platformer where precision, coordination, and timing are key to success. Play locally or online with a friend or family member and dive into a cute, colorful cartoon world… but don’t let the cuteness fool you; things can blow up fast. Every level will put your teamwork, reflexes, and logic to the test.

Designed for both casual players and challenge enthusiasts, Tic Tac offers a progressive experience, full of surprises and unlockable content.

💣 Gameplay

Play as Tic and Tac with your partner and work together to tackle each level's challenges. Study the trap layouts, activate mechanisms, unlock paths, and most of all… pass the bomb at the right moment to reach the goal before the bomb explodes!

Each level challenges you to cooperate, adapt on the fly, and time your moves perfectly to progress as a team.

💣 Communication

Use the emote wheel to interact with your partner throughout the levels. Start a countdown to coordinate a catch, a throw, or a crucial jump. Congratulate your teammate, or tease them gently after a mistake… all in good fun and teamwork!

💣 Scoring

Each level features a time-based scoring system. The faster you finish, the more stars you earn. High scores in certain levels will reward you with outfits or accessories for your character.

💣 Customization

Unlock new outfits for Tic and Tac by completing challenges as you progress through the game. Some items can be obtained by reaching a high score, others can be found in bonus levels, and others will be unlocked under specific conditions. It's up to you to collect them all and display your favorite style in the levels.

💣 Development & future of the project

Our small team of two is developing this game with passion, listening closely to player feedback.

The demo will let you experience the first world, introducing the game's key mechanics through a selection of levels built to test your coordination. Version 1.0 will offer three themed worlds, featuring several main and bonus levels to explore.

If the reception is positive, we will continue to update Tic Tac with more content, mechanics, and challenges. This game is full of potential, and we can't wait to grow this project with you!
